name: ADO classic release
description: Azure DevOps classic releases (the ones under vsrm.dev.azure.com, which the ADO MCP server cannot reach): list definitions, list the builds a definition can take, create a release with chosen builds and held stages, and promote a release to a stage. Ships a tab that picks releases and builds and starts the workflow with them. No AI involved.

args.name: orgUrl
args.label: Organization URL
args.description: https://dev.azure.com/{org}. The release host (vsrm.dev.azure.com) is derived from it.

args.name: operation
args.label: Operation
args.description: definitions lists the release definitions. versions lists the builds each artifact of a definition can take, and its stages. create makes a release from a definition, with pinned builds and held stages. promote starts a release's stage.

args.name: pin
args.label: Builds to pin
args.description: For create: artifact alias to version id, e.g. { "_web-ci": "4821" }. An alias left out takes the definition's default (latest) version.

args.name: hold
args.label: Stages to hold
args.description: For create: stage names whose deployment waits for promote instead of starting on its own, e.g. ["UAT"].

args.name: description
args.label: Release description
args.description: For create. Shown on the release in ADO.

args.name: stage
args.label: Stage
args.description: For promote: the stage name to deploy, e.g. UAT.

args.name: auth
args.label: Auth
args.description: az uses a short-lived token from the CLI's own login - no PAT anywhere. pat is for a machine that cannot have az.

args.name: patEnv
args.label: PAT env var
args.description: Env var holding the personal access token. Read only when auth is pat.
